purpose: Test whether keeping read and write decoding inside a small map tile avoids exporting many decoded control nets without excessive decoder duplication or delay.

proposed_inputs.name: read_hi0
proposed_inputs.meaning: High nibble of the existing first candidate PC

proposed_inputs.name: read_hi1
proposed_inputs.meaning: High nibble of the existing second candidate PC

proposed_inputs.name: write_hi
proposed_inputs.meaning: High nibble of the accepted index address, cursor minus 64

proposed_inputs.name: write_data
proposed_inputs.meaning: Low five data bits of the accepted index push

proposed_inputs.name: write_enable
proposed_inputs.meaning: Accepted index push, inactive bank, matching fixed low nibble; excludes reset and unrelated pushes

clock: Existing chip clock; separate from the 18 functional input bits
schedule: Two combinational reads before the existing SRAM edge; a selected word updates on an accepted upload edge. No new registers, read latency, fetch bubbles or SRAM macros. Map words hold when write_enable is false, including reset.
composition: For each reader, combine partial results using the low candidate-PC nibble and existing bank selection. Global loader admission and atomic ownership remain outside the tile.
checks_before_placement: Define the tile from the existing readTree and Store.next behavior; prove both reads and each stored next value match the current state projection.
Check immediate start, consecutive branches, accepted index pushes, abort/replacement and reset retention through the existing controller contract.
Generate one tile and verify the intended 18-input-bit/10-output-bit functional interface survives the candidate mapping boundary.
Measure decoder duplication, standard-cell area, logic depth, fanout and the complete remaining map glue under the same library and mapping conditions.
A changed chip emission requires a fresh independent RTL/mapped comparison; prior byte-identity receipts do not validate it.
Advance to one bounded placement/global-routing comparison only after a useful complete-chip mapping result or a justified timing tradeoff. Preserve macro locations and the half corridor.
limits: The compact interface is a proposed implementation contract, not a measured reduction from the current tile's 280 incoming nets. No physical experiment is launched by this plan.
